card.title: W25Q16JVSNIM BIOS IC Pinout and Oscilloscope Measurement Guide

source.title: W25Q16JVSNIM BIOS IC Pin Configuration and Description

claims.statement: If communication is present at the DI pin but there is no communication going out at pin DO then firmware / IC could be faulty.
claims.evidence: Text description in the top right corner of the image.

cautions: Check bios pins with oscilloscope and see if there is communication going into the BIOS and also out of the BIOS.
Check if the clock signal is present.
Test signals in standby mode and power on mode.
card.caveats: The image provides general pinout and diagnostic methodology for the W25Q16JVSNIM IC, but does not provide specific board-level schematics or component values for a particular device.
